scope: LF-only byte offsets preserve CRCRLF and interleaving. All source hashes cover complete retained serial files.
Near means80 preceding/150 following LF records, not elapsed seconds. No uniform timestamps support a timed warning window.
Search skips owned marker lines, process-list lines, JSON/binary-image listing rows and rows over4096bytes. Historical crash-report text may contain library names and is not a current warning.
No matching non-owned graphics text follows tap in these logs. No near-tap general warning match; this does not establish absence from original unified logs or target-private output.
Five concrete IOMFB warnings occur in all six runs before their tap marker, so they do not distinguish the failure.
Failed44/47 have subsequent SpringBoard/backboardd PID/UID ps rows, supporting process presence only, not compositor-thread health.
No behavior change or causal diagnosis follows from this negative serial comparison. Next original target stack comparisons remain appropriate.
